CAIDA RouteViews pfx2as: CAIDA Acceptable Use Agreement does not clearly allow redistribution.

method.population: Each Korea-relevant /16 (at least half of its addresses are in an APNIC KR allocation/assignment, or announced with IPtoASN country KR).
method.weight: Organization share is announced addresses in that /16 divided by 65536, not by the Korean slice alone.
method.clearWin: Name the top organization when its share is at least 80%, or it is a major ISP with share at least 50% and a 15 point lead, or any other organization with share at least 70% and a 15 point lead. Otherwise label 혼합.
method.display: Extension shows the name, adds ? when share is under 80, and shows 혼합 for mixed prefixes. Tooltip lists share and other holders at 5% or more (up to 3).

limits: A /16 cannot identify a person or a single subscriber.
VPN exit nodes and CGNAT are not labeled as VPN. Many customers share one prefix.
KT wired and KT mobile are both often originated by AS4766, so they stay 'KT' with kind unknown.
Some LG U+ mobile space is originated by the wired/backbone ASNs and is labeled LG U+, not LG U+ 모바일.
Prefixes that are less than half Korean are omitted, so a thin Korean assignment inside a foreign /16 is not applied to everyone showing that a.b.
